knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A frayed cord is not used. It is reported at once and marked as not to be used. Taping it or using it carefully does not make it safe.
A gas smell calls for no switches or flames, no search for the source, and the emergency steps. Carrying on with the work is not acceptable.
The cleaner checks the visible state only. An unfamiliar appliance is not switched on to demonstrate that it works.

practicalCriteria: Completes a visible check of a sample set of appliances, cords, plugs and safety items, and records each check.
Reports a simulated frayed cord and scorch mark, marks them as not to be used, and does not use them.
Demonstrates the gas-smell response in a role-play, with no switches, no flames and no search for the source.
Records each check with the word checked, and does not record an appliance as safe without an authorised basis.
passRule: Visible checks completed and recorded, faults reported and marked without use, and gas response demonstrated correctly. Observed in a supervised simulation. Not an electrical or gas licence, and not a function test. A knowledge check result is not a practical pass.
stopWorkCriteria: Gas source searched by the cleaner
Switch or flame used during a gas-smell response
Appliance recorded as safe without an authorised basis
